results.title: An API key used on an endpoint that takes no permission
results.evidence: a key scoped to `model:read` reaches 4 of the 75 routes that take no permission, and the boundary is declared rather than assumed: every one of them is named in `AUTHENTICATED_NOT_AUTHORISED`, each answers a closed vocabulary or filters by `visible()` itself, and the build fails on a route added without being listed.
